title: Lockheed Martin expands AI-driven military logistics from F-35 to F-22, F-16 and C-130 fleets to strengthen aircraft readiness | Rune Technologies News
summary: Lockheed Martin is deploying machine-learning systems across military aircraft maintenance and supply chains, with plans to integrate Rune Technologies' adaptive logistics decision platform alongside its existing AI logistics dashboard.
body_markdown:
Defense Industry Europe covered Rune Technologies by Marin Chomsky in a piece titled “Lockheed Martin expands AI-driven military logistics from F-35 to F-22, F-16 and C-130 fleets to strengthen aircraft readiness.” Lockheed Martin is deploying machine-learning systems across military aircraft maintenance and supply chains, with plans to integrate Rune Technologies' adaptive logistics decision platform alongside its existing AI logistics dashboard.


Read the full article[here](https://defence-industry.eu/lockheed-martin-expands-ai-driven-military-logistics-from-f-35-to-f-22-f-16-and-c-130-fleets-to-strengthen-aircraft-readiness/) .
